label: preparing
what: Possibly a surprise gathering marking my forty years as mayor, disguised as the day 1 eighteen-hundred great hall lighting and readiness check. Builder and innkeeper are arranging the hall and my escorted arrival; secretary knowingly coordinates the appointment, though whether the secretary knows of any surprise is uncertain. The lighting check itself is explicit, but a concealed celebration is only an inference; I have no direct evidence of its purpose or of other knowing participants.
